issue.title: Make machine capacity legible and correct
issue.description: The header capacity chip always matches what runner admission sees on this machine, and every unit (or zero) can be traced to a named agent and a stated reason: on the chip, on every Running-bucket row, in a keyboard-reachable inspector, and from `sase agent load`. The athena screenshot case (6 running, 5.0 occupied) reads `5/8`, not `3/8`.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md requests this work

issue.title: Stop the TUI roster from dropping monitors and mislabelling holders
issue.description: roster-fixes: give monitor rows their supervisor PID from agent_meta (then the running marker) on every loader path, index holders by agent row instead of workflow-step rows (closing task bead sase-1ol), and carry runner_claim_owner_key through the roster projection, with loader-level regression tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase roster-fixes as one work unit

issue.title: Per-record capacity accounting in the Rust snapshot
issue.description: core-accounting: in sase-core, add an accounting list (state, charged weight, weight source, claim, reason code) covering every request record, a top-level validity flag, and a monitor-inherited weight input; bump the schema version, update the binding, and adapt sase's record builders and legacy fallback.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase core-accounting as one work unit

issue.title: Shared authoritative machine capacity report
issue.description: machine-report: one read-only Python adapter that builds the machine's capacity report from admission's shared scan cache, a fresh liveness probe, active holds, and the Rust snapshot, plus limit provenance, machine label, age, and a bounded rescan policy.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase machine-report as one work unit

issue.title: The sase agent load command and shared capacity view model
issue.description: load-cli: a TUI-free view model (holders, live rows holding nothing grouped by reason, queued rows with real blockers, diagnostics) rendered by a new `sase agent load [-j]` command, plus a Reference section listing what holds capacity.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase load-cli as one work unit

issue.title: Retire the Python holder predicate behind sase agent list
issue.description: list-holder-parity: source `holds_runner_slot`, `runner_slot_holders`, and `runner_slots_in_use` in `sase agent list -j` from Rust accounting, delete `runner_slot_holder_dirs` and the `status == "RUNNING"` fallback, and add per-entry capacity fields.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase list-holder-parity as one work unit

issue.title: Feed the TUI from the authoritative report
issue.description: tui-report-feed: compute the machine report off the event loop on token change plus a 10 s poll, drive the chip values and row queue context from it, keep the roster projection only as a pre-first-report estimate and drift witness, and log capacity_gauge/capacity_drift telemetry.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase tui-report-feed as one work unit

issue.title: Machine-labelled cap chip with provenance, staleness, fault, and overage
issue.description: cap-chip: rename the gauge to a machine-labelled `cap` chip that keeps its label in compact density, marks overrides, staleness, invalid accounting, and over-limit load, teaches running-versus-cap in the tooltip and `?` help, and fixes the misleading docs example.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase cap-chip as one work unit

issue.title: Occupancy marks on Running rows and a Capacity detail line
issue.description: occupancy-marks: attach accounting entries to Agent rows, draw a charged-now mark on every Running-bucket agent node and clan container (including collapsed clans), and add a never-suppressed `Capacity:` line to agent and clan detail cards.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase occupancy-marks as one work unit

issue.title: Keyboard-first capacity inspector
issue.description: capacity-inspector: a modal rendering the shared view model, opened from a chip click, leader `,l`, and the command palette, with jump-to-agent rows, complete or explicitly truncated lists, real queue blockers, and a copy-snapshot action.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/machine_capacity_transparency.md defines phase capacity-inspector as one work unit

Final code recovers monitor PIDs from meta then running markers, marks recovered PIDs unverified, uses the existing monitor.supervisor_identity wire field with shared process_identity_matches (no extra marker reads), preserves runner_claim_owner_key, and skips only workflow-step children in both capacity maps.
